You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: The robot should first check if the cyan_tray and orange_tray are unoccupied. If not, it must clear them first. Then, pick up the blue_book from the purple_box and place it on the cyan_tray. Next, pick up the yellow_block (currently not on any zone) and place it on the orange_tray. The task is complete when both objects are in their designated zones and no objects remain on the table. Success is verified by confirming both objects are in their correct zones and the table is clear.
Goals: [{"object": "blue_book", "zone": "cyan_tray"}, {"object": "yellow_block", "zone": "orange_tray"}]

Current scene (from the camera):
{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"yellow_block": {"kind": "block", "center": [-0.0699, -0.0799, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8399, "height": 0.0399, "footprint_long": 0.0399, "footprint_short": 0.0392, "long_axis_yaw": 0.245}, "blue_book": {"kind": "book", "center": [0.0682, -0.0668, 0.8144], "top_z": 0.8289, "height": 0.0289, "footprint_long": 0.0747, "footprint_short": 0.0519, "long_axis_yaw": -0.464}}, "zones": {"orange_tray": {"name": "orange_tray", "center": [0.063, 0.1335, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0668]}, "cyan_tray": {"name": "cyan_tray", "center": [-0.1094, 0.254, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0649, 0.0649]}, "purple_box": {"name": "purple_box", "center": [0.0816, -0.0816, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0556, 0.0556]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1979, 0.0003, 1.0799], "yaw": 1.63}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
